_comment: Reviewed Android security baseline enforced by tools/check_android_security.py. Any change to exported components, permissions, or accepted exceptions must be reviewed in a pull request and justified here. See docs/SECURITY.md.

exported_components..ui.player.PlayerActivity: Media player for VIEW/SEND intents from other apps. Incoming intents pass through PlayerIntentSanitizer, which blocks app-private paths, own content authorities and mpv pseudo-protocols.
exported_components..ui.player.WebStreamLinksActivityAlias: Opens supported web video links (YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, ...) in the player. Routed through PlayerActivity and PlayerIntentSanitizer.
exported_components..ui.downloads.QuickDownloadActivity: Accepts shared http(s) links; downloads require an explicit user choice in the quality picker.
exported_components..ui.torrent.TorrentSelectionActivity: Accepts magnet links and .torrent files; external launches require explicit user consent (TorrentConsentTest).
exported_components..ui.mediainfo.MediaInfoActivity: Media information viewer. Incoming intents pass through PlayerIntentSanitizer.
exported_components.androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaTransfer: AndroidX MediaRouter library component required for Cast output switching.
exported_components..utils.media.MediaScanReceiver: Listens for system media-scanner broadcasts; the only effect is a library refresh.

permissions.android.permission.INTERNET: Network playback, network shares, subtitle search, updater.
permissions.android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Local media library on Android 12L and lower (maxSdkVersion 32).
permissions.android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS: Audio output and effects used by the native player. No direct Kotlin reference; review if libmpv audio routing changes.
permissions.android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG: File operations on Android 10 and lower (maxSdkVersion 29).
permissions.android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA: Built-in file manager (copy, move, rename, delete) and secure folder. Subject to Google Play all-files-access policy.
permissions.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP: No service currently declares foregroundServiceType=specialUse. Kept pending maintainer review; remove if unused.
permissions.android.permission.WAKE_LOCK: Keeps playback and downloads alive with the screen off.
permissions.android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO: Optional audio visualizer, requested at runtime only when the user enables it.
permissions.android.permission.POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFIC: Android 16 promoted (live update) notifications for downloads.
permissions.android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA: In-app updater installs SHA-256 verified update APKs.

accepted_exceptions.nsc-base-cleartext: Cleartext HTTP is permitted in base-config because the player must reach user-selected LAN servers, IPTV and WebDAV/HTTP shares whose hosts cannot be enumerated in a static network security config. Jellyfin enforces its own opt-in. Re-review if a per-feature opt-in becomes available for all clients.
